pageCache.text:
At Beavers, we are proud to serve a diverse community where every member of our school is valued as an individual. Our school values of respect, honesty, determination, equality, cooperation and kindness permeate all we strive to achieve. Our friendly staff continually put the children at the heart of all we do. We all share the view that primary school should be a place of happiness, where each individual child can develop and thrive both academically and personally. Our staff have a whole range of strengths, passions and experiences, from maths to Art, sport to libraries, science to drama and everything in between.
Testimonials
I feel my child was truly fortunate to attend Beavers Community School. The staff are exceptionally professional, caring, and supportive. I really appreciated how effectively the school communicates with parents through Tapestry, as well as the active effort to involve us in our children's learning. Inviting parents to participate in school activities and attend workshops on how phonics and maths are taught was invaluable. Access to Reading Eggs was also a wonderful bonus!
Beavers in Numbers

pageCache.pageTitle: Beavers Community Primary School - Wrap Around Care
pageCache.text:
Wrap Around Care
Please note that Breakfast Club and BASH run during term time only
Breakfast Club
Breakfast Club offers before school childcare from 7.45am to 8.40am for a cost of £4.00 per session. Children are provided with breakfast along with a range of fun activities.
To register for Breakfast Club, please complete the registration form and send it to b.moses@beavers.hounslow.sch.uk
Breakfast Club Registration Form
Breakfast Club Registration Form
Beavers After School Hours
Beavers After School Hours offers childcare from 3.10pm to 6.00pm and offers a range of fun activities as well as a nutritional meal.
The cost is £12.50 per pre-booked session or £13.50 for a drop-in (a registration form must be on file before using the drop-in option).
To register, please complete the form below and send it to b.moses@beavers.hounslow.sch.uk
For more information, please click here.
Beavers After School Hours Registration Form
Beavers After School Hours Registration Form
Registration forms are also available from the school office.
© 2026 Beavers Community Primary School · Legal Information
Website design by Greenhouse School Websites

Attendance
Attendance is monitored closely so it is important that parents notify the school at their earliest opportunity to provide the reason for any absence. Parents/Carers are reminded that they have an obligation to ensure their child attends school.
To see our attendance policy please click here
The Headteacher and London Borough of Hounslow do not approve any term time leave and a fixed penalty notice may be issued if you choose to take term time leave.
Where possible please try to make medical appointments outside of school hours, either after school or during the school holidays. If appointments are unavoidable during school time, you must provide proof of the appointment.
NHS Advice: Is my child too ill for school?

pageCache.pageTitle: Beavers Community Primary School - Online Safety
pageCache.text:
Online Safety
E-safety is an important area of your child's education in today’s digital world and is embedded in their learning at school. We have security measures in place in school to help safeguard pupils from potential dangers or unsuitable material.
We can only be successful in keeping children safe online if we work with parents to ensure the E-safety message is consistent. It is important that parents speak to their children about how they can keep safe and behave appropriately online. Please visit our Online Latest News for useful information and factsheets.
The links below are for websites that have lots of information about staying safe online.

pageCache.pageTitle: Beavers Community Primary School - School Day
pageCache.text:
School Day
School hours
Nursery Gate (Beavers Lane)
Nursery Gate (Beavers Lane)
Nursery Gate (Beavers Lane)
Infant Gate (Arundel Road)
Junior Gate (Arundel Road)
Morning registration is at 8:40am and the school day ends at 3:10pm, meaning children are in school for 32.5 hours per week.
It is important that children arrive at school on time so that crucial teaching time is not missed. If you arrive late, please accompany your child to the main school office to sign them in.
If your child is absent, please call the school office before 9am to advise us of the reason.
It is equally important that you collect your child on time at the end of the school day as it can be very upsetting for a child waiting for their parents or carers to arrive. If an unavoidable situation occurs please contact the school office immediately.
You can contact the school office between 8:00am and 4:00pm.

pageCache.pageTitle: Beavers Community Primary School - School Meals
pageCache.text:
School Meals
Our school meals are provided by Lunchtime Co and children are encouraged to have a healthy hot school meal at lunchtime. Under an initiative from the Mayor of London, all primary school children are entitled to a free school meal, meaning that you do NOT have to pay for any meals provided in school.
Menu Summer - Autumn 2026
Packed Lunch
Children not wishing to have a school meal can bring a healthy packed lunch in an appropriate lunchbox. For packed lunch ideas please visit the Change4Life website. Packed lunches should be brought to school in a named lunchbox.

pageCache.pageTitle: Beavers Community Primary School - School Uniform
pageCache.text:
School Uniform
Items with the Beavers Logo* are available from Sanco Schoolwear 60 Bell Road, Hounslow, TW3 3PB, Tel: 020 8570 9990 https://www.sanco.co.uk/school/81/Store Opening Times: Mon to Sat: 9am - 5.30pm, Sun: 11am - 4pm
Non logo items are available at Sanco, but also from other uniform and clothing suppliers
Second Hand Uniform
Please click here or speak to Mrs B Moses to request second-hand uniform. Payment can be made via cash or card directly to Mrs Moses.
If you have any good quality items of uniform that may be of use to another family, please bring them to school.
Please note that children are not permitted to wear any jewellery.
Please ensure that all your child's belongings are named.
Uniform Policy
It is our policy that all children should wear school uniform when attending school, or when participating in a school-organised event outside normal school hours.
